description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of error types observed in a study investigating generalization from atomic skills to complex reasoning tasks. The chart contains five slices, representing the categories “Atomic Skill Fail”, “Correct”, “Reason Error”, “Question Misunderstood”, and an unnamed fifth category. The slices are colored in shades of gray and teal. “Atomic Skill Fail” occupies approximately 12.0% of the chart, “Correct” represents 21.0%, “Reason Error” is approximately 8.0%, “Question Misunderstood” accounts for 14.0%, and the remaining unnamed slice comprises 68.0% of the chart. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, with the largest slice positioned first, and subsequent slices decreasing in size. A legend is provided above the chart, labeling each category with its corresponding color.
